(document.getElementById('destSearchInput')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();\n    const selectedSeason = 
(document.getElementById('destSeasonSelect')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();\n    const times = 
Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.time-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => cb.value.toLowerCase().trim());\n    const 
sortVal = document.querySelector('input[name=\"sort\"]:checked')?.value || 'default';\n    \n    const cards = 
Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.js-dest-card'));\n    let visibleCount = 0;\n    \n    cards.forEach(card => 
{\n        const name = (card.dataset.name || '').toLowerCase();\n        const category = (card.dataset.category || 
'').toLowerCase();\n        const tagline = (card.dataset.tagline || '').toLowerCase();\n        const cardTimes = 
(card.dataset.times || '').split('|').map(t => t.toLowerCase().trim());\n        \n        // 1. Check text search 
match (Where to?)\n        const matchesText = textQuery === '' || name.includes(textQuery) || 
tagline.includes(textQuery) || category.includes(textQuery);\n        \n        // 2. Check season dropdown match 
(Travel Season)\n        const matchesSeason = selectedSeason === '' || cardTimes.includes(selectedSeason);\n        
\n        // 3. Check sidebar checkboxes match\n        const matchesCheckboxes = times.length === 0 || times.some(t 
=> cardTimes.includes(t));\n        \n        // 4. Check Quick-Discovery chip match\n        let matchesQuick = 
true;\n        if (activeQuickFilter === 'domestic') {\n            matchesQuick = (category === 'domestic');\n        
} else if (activeQuickFilter === 'international') {\n            matchesQuick = (category === 'international');\n      
  } else if (activeQuickFilter === 'summer') {\n            matchesQuick = cardTimes.some(t => t.includes('summer') || 
t.includes('monsoon') || t.includes('may') || t.includes('june') || t.includes('july') || t.includes('april'));\n      
  } else if (activeQuickFilter === 'winter') {\n            matchesQuick = cardTimes.some(t => t.includes('winter') ||

t.includes('autumn'));\n        }\n        \n        if (matchesText && matchesSeason && matchesCheckboxes && 
matchesQuick) {\n            card.style.display = 'flex';\n            visibleCount++;\n        } else {\n

container.appendChild(card));\n    \n    if (visibleCount === 0) {\n        if (noResults) noResults.style.display =

document.getElementById('price_max').value = max;\n        applyFiltersAndSort();\n    }\n\n    function 
scrollToCatalogGrid() {\n        applyFiltersAndSort();\n        const el = 
document.getElementById('catalog-main-anchor');\n        if (el) {\n            el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 
'smooth', block: 'start' });\n        }\n    }\n\n    function selectCircleTheme(themeName, btnEl) {\n        // 
Highlight active circle badge\n        document.querySelectorAll('.theme-circle-btn').forEach(b => 
b.classList.remove('active'));\n        if (btnEl) btnEl.classList.add('active');\n\n        // Update search dock 
select\n        const themeSelect = document.getElementById('search_theme_select');\n        if (themeSelect) 
themeSelect.value = themeName;\n\n        // Sync sidebar theme checkboxes\n        
document.querySelectorAll('.theme-checkbox').forEach(cb => {\n            if (themeName === '') {\n                
cb.checked = false;\n            } else {\n                cb.checked = (cb.value.toLowerCase() === 
themeName.toLowerCase());\n            }\n        });\n\n        applyFiltersAndSort();\n    }\n\n    function 
onSearchDockThemeChange() {\n        const selectedVal = 
document.getElementById('search_theme_select').value.toLowerCase();\n        \n        // Sync circle buttons\n        
document.querySelectorAll('.theme-circle-btn').forEach(btn => {\n            const titleText = 
btn.querySelector('.theme-circle-title').textContent.trim().toLowerCase();\n            if (selectedVal === '' && 
titleText.includes('all')) {\n                btn.classList.add('active');\n            } else if (selectedVal !== '' 
&& titleText.includes(selectedVal)) {\n                btn.classList.add('active');\n            } else {\n            
    btn.classList.remove('active');\n            }\n        });\n\n        // Sync sidebar theme checkboxes\n        
document.querySelectorAll('.theme-checkbox').forEach(cb => {\n            if (selectedVal === '') {\n                
cb.checked = false;\n            } else {\n                cb.checked = (cb.value.toLowerCase() === selectedVal);\n    
        }\n        });\n\n        applyFiltersAndSort();\n    }\n\n    function onSidebarThemeChange() {\n        
const activeThemeCbs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.theme-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => 
cb.value.toLowerCase());\n        \n        // Update dock select & circles if exactly 1 theme is checked\n        
const themeSelect = document.getElementById('search_theme_select');\n        if (activeThemeCbs.length === 1) {\n      
      const chosen = activeThemeCbs[0];\n            if (themeSelect) themeSelect.value = chosen;\n            
document.querySelectorAll('.theme-circle-btn').forEach(btn => {\n                const titleText = 
btn.querySelector('.theme-circle-title').textContent.trim().toLowerCase();\n                
btn.classList.toggle('active', titleText.includes(chosen));\n            });\n        } else if (activeThemeCbs.length 
=== 0) {\n            if (themeSelect) themeSelect.value = '';\n            
document.querySelectorAll('.theme-circle-btn').forEach(btn => {\n                const titleText = 
btn.querySelector('.theme-circle-title').textContent.trim().toLowerCase();\n                
btn.classList.toggle('active', titleText.includes('all'));\n            });\n        }\n        
applyFiltersAndSort();\n    }\n    \n    function applyFiltersAndSort() {\n        const activeThemes = 
Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.theme-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => cb.value.toLowerCase());\n        const 
activeDests = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dest-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => cb.value.toLowerCase());\n     
   const activeDurs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.duration-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => cb.value);\n       
 \n        // Add duration from search dock if selected and not checked in sidebar\n        const dockDur = 
document.getElementById('search_dur_select') ? document.getElementById('search_dur_select').value : '';\n        if 
(dockDur !== '' && !activeDurs.includes(dockDur)) {\n            activeDurs.push(dockDur);\n        }\n\n        // 
Add theme from search dock if selected and not checked in sidebar\n        const dockTheme = 
document.getElementById('search_theme_select') ? document.getElementById('search_theme_select').value.toLowerCase() : 
'';\n        if (dockTheme !== '' && !activeThemes.includes(dockTheme)) {\n            activeThemes.push(dockTheme);\n 
       }\n        \n        const priceMinInput = document.getElementById('price_min').value;\n        const 
priceMaxInput = document.getElementById('price_max').value;\n        const priceMin = priceMinInput !== '' ? 
parseFloat(priceMinInput) : 0;\n        const priceMax = priceMaxInput !== '' ? parseFloat(priceMaxInput) : 
Infinity;\n        \n        const sortVal = document.querySelector('input[name=\"catalog_sort\"]:checked') ? 
document.querySelector('input[name=\"catalog_sort\"]:checked').value : 'default';\n        \n        // Keyword text 
search filter\n        const keywordVal = document.getElementById('search_keyword_input') ? 
document.getElementById('search_keyword_input').value.trim().toLowerCase() : '';\n\n        const cards = 
Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.js-catalog-card'));\n        let visibleCount = 0;\n        \n        // 1. 
Filter logic\n        cards.forEach(card => {\n            const cardPrice = 
parseFloat(card.getAttribute('data-price'));\n            const cardDest = card.getAttribute('data-destination');\n    
        const cardThemes = card.getAttribute('data-themes').split('|');\n            const cardDur = 
card.getAttribute('data-duration');\n            const cardTitle = card.getAttribute('data-title');\n            \n    
        let matchTheme = true;\n            if (activeThemes.length > 0) {\n                matchTheme = 
cardThemes.some(t => activeThemes.includes(t));\n            }\n            \n            let matchDest = true;\n      
      if (activeDests.length > 0) {\n                matchDest = activeDests.includes(cardDest);\n            }\n      
      \n            let matchDur = true;\n            if (activeDurs.length > 0) {\n                matchDur = 
activeDurs.includes(cardDur);\n            }\n            \n            let matchPrice = (cardPrice >= priceMin && 
cardPrice <= priceMax);\n            \n            let matchKeyword = true;\n            if (keywordVal !== '') {\n    
            matchKeyword = (cardTitle.includes(keywordVal) || cardDest.includes(keywordVal) || cardThemes.some(t => 
t.includes(keywordVal)));\n            }\n            \n            if (matchTheme && matchDest && matchDur && 
matchPrice && matchKeyword) {\n                card.style.display = 'block';\n                setTimeout(() => { 
card.style.opacity = '1'; card.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'; }, 20);\n                visibleCount++;\n           
 } else {\n                card.style.opacity = '0';\n                card.style.transform = 'translateY(15px)';\n     
           setTimeout(() => { card.style.display = 'none'; }, 250);\n            }\n        });\n        \n        // 
2. Sort logic\n        const gridInner = document.getElementById('packages-grid-inner');\n        if (gridInner) {\n   
         cards.sort((a, b) => {\n                const priceA = parseFloat(a.getAttribute('data-price'));\n            
    const priceB = parseFloat(b.getAttribute('data-price'));\n                const daysA = 
parseInt(a.getAttribute('data-days'));\n                const daysB = parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-days'));\n         
       const createdA = parseInt(a.getAttribute('data-created'));\n                const createdB = 
parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-created'));\n                \n                if (sortVal === 'price_asc') {\n          
          return priceA - priceB;\n                } else if (sortVal === 'price_desc') {\n                    return 
priceB - priceA;\n                } else if (sortVal === 'duration_asc') {\n                    return daysA - 
daysB;\n                } else if (sortVal === 'duration_desc') {\n                    return daysB - daysA;\n         
       } else {\n                    return createdB - createdA;\n                }\n            });\n            
cards.forEach(card => gridInner.appendChild(card));\n        }\n        \n        // 3. Update live results badge\n    
    const badge = document.getElementById('resultsCountBadge');\n        if (badge) {\n            badge.textContent = 
visibleCount + ' Tour Packages Available';\n        }\n\n        // 4. Render Empty placeholder\n        const 
emptyState = document.getElementById('no-packages-placeholder');\n        if (emptyState) {\n            if 
(visibleCount === 0) {\n                emptyState.style.display = 'flex';\n            } else {\n                
emptyState.style.display = 'none';\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    function resetAllFilters() {\n        
document.querySelectorAll('.theme-checkbox').forEach(cb => cb.checked = false);\n        
document.querySelectorAll('.dest-checkbox').forEach(cb => cb.checked = false);\n        
document.querySelectorAll('.duration-checkbox').forEach(cb => cb.checked = false);\n        if

document.querySelector('input[name=\"budget_tier\"][value=\"all\"]').checked = true;\n        }\n

(document.getElementById('search_keyword_input')) document.getElementById('search_keyword_input').value = '';\n        
if (document.getElementById('search_theme_select')) document.getElementById('search_theme_select').value = '';\n       
 if (document.getElementById('search_dur_select')) document.getElementById('search_dur_select').value = '';\n\n        
// Reset theme circles\n        document.querySelectorAll('.theme-circle-btn').forEach(btn => {\n            const 
titleText = btn.querySelector('.theme-circle-title').textContent.trim().toLowerCase();\n            
btn.classList.toggle('active', titleText.includes('all'));\n        });\n\n        applyFiltersAndSort();\n    }\n
